Study — The Agreement Nobody Can Find.questDesignBrief: Archive research and deliberately desk work: the Lineage Records Alcove, Sovian Ravello's check of the entry, Veylan Ravello's restoration shelf, the Record Integrity Station and, only if Maereth allows it, the Sealed Record Vaults; each door can be refused. The finding may be a catalogue error, a document never filed, a document removed or a reference that was itself the alteration; Caleon Ravello may know what a Castro would want kept quiet and say nothing. Do not make the archive a conspiracy or resolve pre-Darkstar political history. Pays: Nessa Ravello pays 105–160 Credits on completion.

completionCondition.query: Maereth Ravello has received the traced finding on Nessa Ravello's missing agreement and has entered it, sealed it or refused it, with Nessa's name on the work. An attempt, promise or partial result does not count.

Study — The Agreement Nobody Can Find.id: Study — The Agreement Nobody Can Find
Study — The Agreement Nobody Can Find.definitionKey: Study — The Agreement Nobody Can Find

Study — Readings from the Flooded Founda.name: Study — Readings from the Flooded Foundation
Study — Readings from the Flooded Founda.questStatement: Nexis Contair's field study of the Old Conduit Housing and the Flooded Foundation Walk in Low Relstaris can only go ahead if residents agree in person, and none of his students can get past Dessa Sol's door. He needs someone Low Relstaris will speak to, who can also take readings down in flooded tunnels.
Study — Readings from the Flooded Founda.mainObjective: Win Dessa Sol and the residents over, take the readings in the Flooded Foundation Walk, and put the data in Nexis Contair's hands.
Study — Readings from the Flooded Founda.questLocation: Academy Research and Applied Sciences Campus
Study — Readings from the Flooded Founda.questDesignBrief: Dessa Sol may refuse, set terms or agree only to the Flooded Foundation Walk, and a resident may pull out midway, which stops readings on their row. The Walk itself is dangerous: rising water, rotten conduit and bad footing. Readings are structural and water-system measurements only, no watching residents, nothing touching the Relstaris Core, and no promise of repairs the Academy cannot keep. Pays: Nexis Contair pays 150–300 Credits on completion.

completionCondition.query: The player has won residents' agreement in person, taken the readings in the Old Conduit Housing and the Flooded Foundation Walk, and handed the data to Nexis Contair, or has brought Dessa Sol's refusal to Nexis's face. An attempt, promise or partial result does not count.

Study — Readings from the Flooded Founda.id: Study — Readings from the Flooded Foundation
Study — Readings from the Flooded Founda.definitionKey: Study — Readings from the Flooded Foundation

Study — The Hand Behind the Mark.name: Study — The Hand Behind the Mark
Study — The Hand Behind the Mark.questStatement: A working charm sold on the Charm Piecework Edge carries an Open Circle certification mark the Certification Hall never issued. Quenna Sil wants to find who wrote the charm and who put the mark on it before the Common Scale Hall, Corsair's magic branch or the market decides what it means.
Study — The Hand Behind the Mark.mainObjective: Track the charm back to the hand that wrote it and the hand that marked it, and bring them face to face with Quenna Sil.
Study — The Hand Behind the Mark.questDesignBrief: The seller on the Charm Piecework Edge packs up and runs once questions start; Bareth Kollo knows every face and who paid for which stall, and Maelrix Corsair can read the working though Quenna keeps the Circle's independence from him. The trail may end at a student who did honest uncertified work and could be ruined by the truth. Ordinary route or ward charm only, nothing from the Restricted Archives; do not resolve the forged Common Scale Hall seal. Pays: Quenna Sil pays 150–300 Credits on completion.

completionCondition.query: The player has found who wrote the charm and who put the mark on it, and has brought that person or those people before Quenna Sil at the Open Circle to answer for it in person. An attempt, promise or partial result does not count.

Study — The Hand Behind the Mark.id: Study — The Hand Behind the Mark
Study — The Hand Behind the Mark.definitionKey: Study — The Hand Behind the Mark
